before Google did — and used it against real people.

news.title: CISA alert: Adobe Commerce and Google Brotli flaws actively exploited — patch immediately
news.excerpt: Update Adobe Commerce/Magento and your browser to latest versions — check cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog for details

news.title: CISA flags exploited Windows zero-day — patch at Settings > Windows Update by October 16
news.excerpt: CISA added CVE-2026-96207, an actively exploited Windows Shell zero-day, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 13. Microsoft fixed it in the October Patch Tuesday release (1,413 total vulnerabilities addressed). Federal agencies must apply the patch by October 16; you should update promptly. Open Settings > Windows Update and check for updates now.

news.title: Fake Shipping Texts Flooding Phones — Don't Tap the Link
news.excerpt:
Fake shipping texts are flooding phones right now — messages claiming a parcel from a major carrier couldn't be delivered and asking you to tap a link to reschedule. The link leads to a fake page that steals your login info and payment details. Carriers never ask for payment or login info by text.

What to do: Delete the text. If you're expecting a shipment, go to the carrier's website directly (type the address yourself) or use their official app. Forward suspicious texts to 7726 (SPAM) so…

news.title: Microsoft October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,413 flaws including exploited Windows Shell zero-day — update at Settings > Windows Update
news.excerpt: Microsoft released its October 2026 security update fixing 1,413 vulnerabilities including one actively exploited Windows Shell zero-day (CVE-2026-96951) that lets attackers bypass Mark of the Web warnings. Open Settings → Windows Update → turn on "Get the latest updates as soon as they're available" → select Check for updates to install it now.

posts.title: CISA adds critical PHP flaws to exploited list — patch now at php.net
posts.summary: CISA added two PHP vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 26. Attackers are actively using these "php2shell" flaws for remote code execution. If you run a website or server with PHP, update to the latest PHP version immediately at php.net/downloads.

posts.title: Comcast fiber expansion brings high-speed internet to rural Columbia County through state partnership
posts.summary: Check your address at xfinity.com — Comcast's public-private partnership added 3,300+ Lake City area homes with more coming through 2026
posts.truth: Slow internet isn't a computer problem — it's an infrastructure problem. I've had customers buy new PCs thinking that'll fix buffering video, when their 10 Mbps DSL is the bottleneck. Comcast's fiber build (started August 2026) is changing that for Ellisville, Fort White, Mikesville, and Lake City proper. Check your address — you might qualify now.

posts.title: Firefox 159 adds Smart Window price-drop alerts and sidebar passwords — free update at firefox.com
posts.summary: Update Firefox to 159 at firefox.com or via menu > Help > About Firefox to get Smart Window page-watching and passwords in the sidebar
posts.truth: Firefox keeps adding features people actually use instead of bloat. Smart Window lets you type /watch on any page — price drops, restocks, ticket availability — and Firefox notifies you. Passwords now live in the sidebar by default, no extra clicks. It's the browser that respects your time.

posts.title: Record-breaking Microsoft Patch Tuesday: 1,411 vulnerabilities fixed including 3 zero-days
posts.summary: Run Windows Update at Settings > Windows Update — the October Patch Tuesday release includes fixes for one actively exploited and two publicly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities
posts.truth: Most people ignore Windows updates until something breaks. I see it every week — a computer gets hit by something that Microsoft patched months ago. The October update is massive (1,411 flaws!) and includes an actively exploited zero-day in Windows Shell that lets attackers bypass Mark of the Web. Don't wait.

posts.title: Run private AI chatbots on your computer free offline — Ollama LM Studio Jan GPT4All compared
posts.summary: Want ChatGPT-like AI without the cloud? Four free tools let you run models locally: Ollama (command line, ollama.com), LM Studio (graphical, lmstudio.ai), Jan (chat interface, jan.ai), and GPT4All (simple desktop app, gpt4all.io). All work offline, no account needed, your data never leaves your computer. Download any from their official sites.
posts.truth: Customers ask me about AI constantly. Most don't realize you can run a capable chatbot on a regular laptop with 8GB RAM — no subscription, no internet, total privacy. I run LM Studio on my shop machine for drafting emails and summarizing repair notes. It's not magic, but it's genuinely useful and costs nothing.

posts.title: **Headline:** Microsoft Edge 156 patches security holes — update free at edge://settings/help
posts.summary: Microsoft released Edge 156 on October 22 (main release) and 156.0.4314.50 on October 26 with security fixes. Open Edge, click the three-dot menu → Help and feedback → About Microsoft Edge. It checks and installs updates automatically. Restart when prompted.
posts.truth: Most people ignore browser updates until something breaks. I see it weekly — outdated browsers are the #1 way malware gets in. Updating takes 30 seconds and costs nothing.

posts.title: Windows Storage Sense deletes old Downloads and Recycle Bin files automatically — free in Settings
posts.summary: Go to Settings > System > Storage > Storage Sense and turn it on — set it to clean Downloads after 30 days and Recycle Bin after 14 days
posts.truth: The number one reason computers slow down isn't age — it's a stuffed C: drive. I've seen 50 GB of installers sitting in Downloads from 2022. Storage Sense handles this quietly in the background. Turn it on once, forget it exists.

posts.title: **Headline:** WinTuner is the safe Windows 11 optimizer that launches 23 built-in tools free — no risky cleaners no telemetry
posts.summary: Download WinTuner free at github.com/Mwoodring2/WinTuner, run as administrator, and use its unified search to launch God Mode tools, clean temp files, and apply reversible tweaks with full undo support.
posts.truth: I see PCs every week "optimized" by system cleaners that broke more than they fixed. WinTuner is different — it only surfaces tools Microsoft already built in, shows you the risk level of every tweak, and logs every change so you can undo it. That's the optimizer I'd run on my own machine.

posts.title: Make a bootable USB free — BalenaEtcher flashes OS images safely at balenaetcher.io
posts.summary: Download BalenaEtcher free from balenaetcher.io (Windows, Mac, or Linux). Plug in your USB drive, select your ISO file, select the drive, click Flash. It validates the write so you know the drive will boot. No command line, no guesswork.
posts.truth: I've fixed more "bricked" USB drives from people using dd or Rufus wrong than I can count. Etcher hides your system drives by default so you can't accidentally wipe your hard drive. That one feature has saved customers' data dozens of times.

posts.title: Make games run smoother free — Windows 11 Game Mode and hardware graphics scheduling hide a free performance boost in Settings
posts.summary: Open Settings → Gaming → Game Mode. Turn on Game Mode. Then scroll to Hardware-accelerated graphics scheduling and turn that on too. Restart. Games get priority access to your processor and graphics card — no new hardware needed.
posts.truth: People spend $500 on a video card but leave the free Windows gaming toggles off. I've seen 10–15% speed gains just from flipping these two switches. Works on any graphics card from the last 5 years.
